alt: Two electronic sensor tiles displaying white lily flowers on a grey metal base with holes, alongside four blue square tiles, one with a white letter W, positioned near the edge of a green cutting mat with white markings.
caption: Electronic components and white lilies arranged on a perforated workspace surface.
description: Small square chips featuring printed white lilies sit on a grey metal plate with a grid of holes. Next to the floral modules are small square ceramic tiles in varying shades of blue, one marked with a white letter W. A green cutting mat with white measurement markings is visible at the bottom right corner.
